occurrences.text: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.
Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
